summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship phase 63 (Read-Chain Navigation and Rotation Core) for the CipherBox project using the GSD autonomous pipeline.
summary.outcome: Planning completed successfully with 7 plans across 4 waves, verified by the plan-checker on iteration 2 (all 12 dimensions passed, 7/7 requirements and 10/10 decisions covered). Execution began with Wave 1 — plan 63-01 (navigation walk) completed, 63-02 (grant issuance + invite re-wrap crypto) dispatched. The transcript ends mid-Wave 1 before execution finished.

repo: Phase 63 builds the read-chain navigation walk, grant/invite crypto, and rotation engine with 4 named Phase-64 seams.

The project has a known GSD commit helper false-negative where it reports failure but git log confirms the commit landed — verified pattern across at least 3 commits (855ce39f3, 2c9ef1859, f8be4477c).

The project's worktree approach has documented pitfalls (node_modules leaks, api:generate leaks) — the planner explicitly recommended sequential in-context execution over worktrees due to shared folder.test.ts between plans 63-01 and 63-04.
API health endpoint is at localhost:3000/health; CI already uses a bounded poll loop (curl -fsS) to wait for startup rather than sleep.
commit.gpgsign was already set to false locally; no biometric prompts expected during autonomous execution.
The codebase map in .planning/codebase/ was stale (flagged by drift gate) but non-blocking at plan time — CONTEXT.md + RESEARCH.md carried precise, verified current implementation-site references.
API-SURFACE regenerated as empty (0 symbols) for this phase — sdk-core is backend crypto with no UI surface.

Wave structure: Wave 1 (63-01, 63-02, 63-03: navigation + crypto + rotation engine), Wave 2 (63-04, 63-05: mutations + invariants + barrel), Wave 3 (63-06: delete reWrapForRecipients + rewire sdk add-item), Wave 4 (63-07: live sdk-e2e round-trip).

code.finding: Plan 63-07 originally used fragile `sleep 12` for API startup; replaced with bounded health-poll loop mirroring the CI pattern (curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health).
Open Questions section needed a `(RESOLVED)` marker added — the questions were substantively answered but the heading wasn't annotated, which blocked the plan-checker.

VALIDATION.md must be filled with per-task verification map and nyquist_compliant: true during the checker-fix iteration, not left as a template stub — plan-checker flags it as a warning if left empty.

workflow: The GSD plan-checker caught 1 blocker + 2 warnings on iteration 1, all in phase artifacts (formatting/tracking), not plan design — fixing them directly and re-running the checker is cheaper than replanning.
The plan-checker runs independently as a subagent and should always be re-spawned after fixes rather than self-certifying — this preserves the gate's integrity.
VALIDATION.md body is populated during the checker-fix loop, not during initial plan creation (step 5.5 only creates the frontmatter stub).
The execute-phase workflow has a safe-resume gate (checks for partial commits / .continue-here.md) that should be cleared before dispatching Wave 1.
Sequential execution in the main tree (no worktrees) is the preferred mode for phases with cross-plan file coupling and documented worktree pitfalls.
The GSD plan:pre and execute:pre hook lists should be checked before each major phase to catch biometric/sign-off blockers that would hang unattended runs.

friction: GSD commit helper reports false-negatives (exit code non-zero) even when commits land successfully — required manual `git log` verification after every commit to confirm success.

plan-checker iteration 1 blocked on a RESEARCH.md formatting issue (missing RESOLVED marker) and an unfilled VALIDATION.md template — both were mechanical fixes but required a full second checker spawn.
The transcript ends mid-execution (after 63-01 complete, 63-02 dispatched) — the user's original request included /ship-phase 63 but that was never reached in the session.
open_items: Wave 1 plan 63-02 (grant issuance + invite re-wrap crypto) was still running when the transcript ended — completion unconfirmed.
Waves 2, 3, and 4 (plans 63-04 through 63-07) not yet executed.
/ship-phase 63 (PR creation and review) deferred until execution completes.
The stale codebase map in .planning/codebase/ was noted as non-blocking at plan time but not refreshed — may need updating before or after phase 63 completes.
Phase-64 seams were named during rotation engine planning (plan 63-03) but the actual Phase 64 planning is deferred.
